fixedFacts._comment: One wording per fact, used everywhere.
fixedFacts.localPricing: local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added

fixedFacts.included: blankets, shrink wrap, tape and truck costs (gas, mileage, tolls) are included in the hourly rate
fixedFacts.longDistance: long distance moves are quoted at a flat rate
fixedFacts.storage: storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up
